conf.description: Forcepoint DLP administrator audit log, syslog/CEF (10.2+), per recommendations.direct.cribl. Same transport and CEF header/extension parse as the incident pipeline; branches on the 'DLP Audit Log' Name header. cat/act/suser carry different objects here than on the incident branch (Topic, Action Performed, admin identity vs policy category, enforcement action, violation source) and are mapped independently so the shared CEF keys never cross-contaminate the two streams. suser is split into display name + username; role really is the acting admin's role here (unlike the sibling Forcepoint Web audit feed) so user.roles is correct.

functions.description: Split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension string.

Extract every CEF extension key=value pair. Non-greedy value + lookahead on the next key= (or end of string) so multi-word values like msg are not cut at the first space, which a naive kv splitter would do.
Keep only audit records, discriminated by the 'DLP Audit Log' Name header.
Batch-rename every status:mapped field to its ECS target (act/msg mean Action Performed/details here, not the incident branch's objects).

Derive event.outcome/event.category (Log on/Log out is iam, everything else configuration); split suser into user.name/user.full_name; emit user.roles as a single-element array; relocate Topic and Modified Item to forcepoint.dlp.audit.*.
Fallback event time from the syslog header.
Set _time from timeStamp (assumed UTC, no offset in the record - see README); tag event.dataset.
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
